content.text: Skip To Main Content Select WeekWeek 1Week 2Week 3Week 4Week 5Week 6Week 7Week 8Week 9Week 10Fri, April 038:00 PM EDTFOXDC DefendersColumbus AviatorsBuy TicketsWatchSat, April 048:00 PM EDTESPNLouisville KingsOrlando StormBuy TicketsWatchSun, April 056:00 PM EDTNFLNBirmingham StallionsHouston GamblersBuy TicketsWatchTue, April 078:00 PM EDTFS1St. Louis BattlehawksDallas RenegadesBuy TicketsWatch Full Scoreboard Full Scoreboard UFL to NFL Signings UpdateSigned to the Dallas Cowboys practice squad, Dalton is one of 18 players from the 2024 UFL class in the NFLOctober 16, 2024Arlington, TX (October 16, 2024) - The United Football League today announced that San Antonio defensive lineman Jalen Dalton has become the 80th player from this past season to have signed with an NFL team.Signed to the Dallas Cowboys practice squad, Dalton is one of 18 players from the 2024 UFL class in the NFL, joining Jake Bates, Adrian Martinez, Jalen Redmond, and Dondrea Tillman who are on active rosters, 13 other players on practice squads and one on injured reserve.For all the latest UFL to NFL signings visit the UFL Media Portal. About the United Football LeagueThe United Football League (UFL) is the premier spring football platform, formed by the merger of the XFL and USFL in 2024 under the combined ownership of Redbird Capital Partners, FOX, Dany Garcia and Dwayne Johnson.
